title: 美联储前主席罕见表态：加息25点，不是为了经济而是为了面子
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The former Philadelphia Fed president, Patrick Harker, writing, washes three elephants in that room, inflation, the treasury market, and the fiscal situation,
segments.zh: 前费城联储主席帕特里克·哈克写道，房间里有三头大象：通胀、国债市场和财政状况。

segments.en: underneath both. Watch what he addresses rather than what he promises.
segments.zh: 在这两者之下，关注他实际处理的问题，而不是他的承诺。

segments.en: Patrick joins us now for more. Patrick, welcome to the program, sir. Always good to hear from you.
segments.zh: 帕特里克现在加入我们。欢迎来到节目，先生。很高兴听到你的见解。

segments.en: Out of those elephants, what does he have the most influence over?
segments.zh: 在这些大象中，他对哪个最有影响力？

segments.en: Yeah, good question. So he clearly doesn't have influence over the long-end of the Yield curve.
segments.zh: 好问题。显然，他对收益率曲线的长端没有影响力。

segments.en: That's never been the case, right? He does have influence over inflation, and the credibility of the Fed in terms of inflation fighting.
segments.zh: 从来都是如此，对吧？他对通胀以及美联储在抗通胀方面的信誉有影响力。

segments.en: It's not enough just to say we're going to be tough on inflation. You actually have to do something.
segments.zh: 仅仅说我们要对抗通胀是不够的，你必须采取实际行动。

segments.en: Now, I think I was listening to your comments earlier, raising the short end by 25, 50 basis points
segments.zh: 我听到你之前的评论，将短期利率提高25或50个基点。

segments.en: is it going to make a huge difference? No, but it's signaling what the Fed means when it says it's tough on inflation.
segments.zh: 这会带来巨大变化吗？不会，但这传递了美联储在通胀问题上强硬立场的信号。

segments.en: Patrick, do you think there are questions being asked of this Fed chair that weren't being asked of the former Fed chair?
segments.zh: 帕特里克，你认为现在向这位美联储主席提出的问题，是前任主席没有遇到过的吗？

segments.en: Is there something about the switch here that has raised questions about credibility, that little bit more because of the pressure that institutions come under over the past 18 months?
segments.zh: 这种转变是否因为过去18个月机构面临的压力，而引发了对可信度的更多质疑？

segments.en: No, I don't think so. I don't think that's the issue. I think the issue is the circumstances we have, right?
segments.zh: 不，我不这么认为。问题不在于此，而在于我们当前所处的环境。

segments.en: Right now, we have inflation. We're going on to six years soon of inflation above target.
segments.zh: 目前通胀高企，我们即将迎来通胀高于目标水平的第六个年头。
